The desktop opening is an atmospheric coastal scene followed by reservation, location, lodging, food, activities, community, journal, and contact chapters. Source logos, Michelin and Relais & Chateaux marks, property imagery, rates, room counts, community claims, and destination facts are reference-only.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A destination-first inn page uses the North Atlantic coast as its opening scene. A slim navigation row places booking beside destination and stay paths; an atmospheric full-bleed landscape carries a direct date-selection action. The page then moves from place context to lodging/rates, food, island experiences, community purpose, recent stories, and a richly linked footer. Photography and narrative are the primary navigational structure, with warm dark overlays and minimal surface chrome. This actual hotel is a visual reference only: its remote-island identity, community model, awards, copy, property, amenities, rates, photos, operating claims and booking details are not reusable client facts.

heroGeometry.mode: immersive full-bleed coastal scene beneath a restrained reservation/navigation rail
heroGeometry.alignment: small wordmark and reserve action sit across the top; image atmosphere fills the viewport while the lodging promise and date action remain direct
heroGeometry.viewport: hero communicates a stay experience and exposes the first booking action without a multi-card dashboard

navigationGeometry.mode: low-chrome destination navigation with direct reserve action
navigationGeometry.placement: wordmark left, stay/destination/food/news paths across the center, reserve at the far edge
navigationGeometry.mobile: collapse destinations behind a menu while preserving a prominent reservation action

typography.display: quiet contemporary grotesk with occasional editorial serif accents
typography.scale: large place-led statement, restrained captions, short section introductions, clear booking labels

palette.contrastIntent: photographic overlays protect white navigation and hero text; body sections switch to calm light surfaces for sustained reading

imageTreatment.mode: large natural landscape, then specific room, food, and island imagery
imageTreatment.crop: wide hero crop transitions into varied editorial image panels and smaller destination cards
imageTreatment.focalPoint: shoreline light and rugged Atlantic coast establish place; client-owned imagery must carry the new business's actual destination

servicePresentation.pattern: lodging is organized as an experience journey: stay, arrival, food, and activities, each with its own specific route
servicePresentation.interaction: date selection, reservation link, visitor-controlled image/content rails, and destination details; use only integrations the client actually has

ctaPlacement.primary: date-selection/reservation action inside the opening scene
ctaPlacement.secondary: arrival or stay-details path after the location context
ctaPlacement.early: lodging details and rates follow place context before editorial/community chapters

motion.primitive: slow image reveal or gentle scene transition that reinforces a destination rather than concealing room/rate facts
motion.library: native CSS or GSAP only where a measured reveal is purposeful
motion.reducedMotion: static hero crop and complete visible image/section content

mobileRecomposition.strategy: immersive opening followed by stacked stay-planning chapters
